$comment: An example world setting (owner, 2026-11-10: "at least 5000m tall elevations like mount rainier is 4392m tall"), never a world's own: terrain.json's elevation with one convergent plate boundary and one dormant stratovolcano behind it, 4800 m high and 12 km in radius with a 400 m crater, hardened against the erosion (coneHardness) so it keeps its relief on the 100 m map. Shaped like Rainier (0.52.40): 14 radial ridges with glacier-cut valleys up to 450 m deep, the summit 900 m off the centre (one flank steeper), a shoulder peak (a Liberty Cap), three flank cones (a Little Tahoma), the crater an ice dome (above 3000 m), and a snow line from temperature at 0 °C (~1970 m with the 0.3/km lapse rate) leaving faces steeper than 1.1 bare rock; glacier ice (0.52.45) on the gentle ground colder than −10 °C (~3500 m), the crater's dome among it. Tests build it by data alone (FIXTURE_WORLDS, WorldMap::for_height); Chisel offers it as a preset. Prototype content.
name: test:tall_peak
